assessment_basis: Explicit synthetic output-equivalence proof and exhaustive small conditional-null arithmetic; no native experiment.
reason: The proposed contrast can describe departure from independent half pairing but cannot select whole-base copying over repeated-feature templates or learned whole forms. The three toy writers have pointwise identical outputs. Seam conditioning can also remove all comparison mobility for a real copying writer. No native run selected; this is not a refutation of native repetition or a declaration that conditional null tests are invalid.

blockers.detail: No stated extra observable consequence separates the candidate writers; a significant pairing dependence does not establish a copying operation.

all_of.detail: State two concrete competing writer contracts and an additional observable consequence on which they differ, with a justified source/null contract and decision-changing outcome.

not_sufficient: More permutations or stronger significance of the same half identity statistic
Relax conditioning after examining native capacity
Treat a mathematical toy p-value as manuscript evidence
Treat this review as refuting all reduplication or all descriptive pairing analyses
